name: Council of Demons
source:
You play as Veta, an 8th grader who made a deal with a demon, then seduced an angel into sin. Her bold actions earned her a place in the Demon Council – a secret group for outcast demons. 

When their leader is taken during the angel-demon war, the council seeks revenge.

[From [url=https://monikagott.itch.io/council-of-demons]Itch.io[/url]]
